name: Hermes Agent
postCreateCommand: set -e; LOG=/tmp/hermes_full_setup.log; echo === $(date) Full setup start === > $LOG; echo '[1/3] Starting Docker...' >> $LOG; cd $CODESPACE_VSCODE_FOLDER; docker compose up -d >> $LOG 2>&1; docker compose ps >> $LOG 2>&1; echo '[2/3] Installing hermes-web-ui...' >> $LOG; npm install -g hermes-web-ui >> $LOG 2>&1; echo '[3/3] Starting hermes-web-ui on 8648...' >> $LOG; nohup hermes-web-ui start 8648 --no-open >> $LOG 2>&1 & sleep 3; ss -tlnp | grep -E 8648\|9119 >> $LOG 2>&1; echo === Setup done at $(date) === >> $LOG
